name: functions-and-nil-test-b8a729fc06/functions_with_nil_basics-v.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: the supported expression list includes Type test expression, Anonymous function expression and Error constructor, but does not include typeof expression.
## Statements: [Return], [Panic], [If/else] and [Local variable declarations] are supported.
### Other invocation restrictions: `error:message` and `value:toString` and `value:toBalString` are supported with method call syntax.
reason: The nil-return, optional-error return, anonymous-function invocation and nil-assignment checks use supported constructs, but their failure diagnostics contain `(typeof e).toString()`. The typeof expression is absent from the supported expression list, so the complete case requires an uncovered construct even though these panic branches are not reached on a successful run.
unsupported_constructs: typeof expression in the panic diagnostics of funcReturnNilOrError and funcReturnOptionallyError
test_design_notes: io:println is output instrumentation. The unsupported typeof expressions occur only on assertion-failure paths; replacing their diagnostic text would leave the substantive nil-return checks within the listed constructs.
